prompts.name: tier-5-elite
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate TIER 5 ELITE GUARDS game concept sheet in the EXACT clean very low-poly style of the attached style reference: broad flat faces, simple block-like forms, chunky cute proportions, matte solid colors, tiny black dot eyes, simple closed-mouth marks when idle. Three rows and two columns: IDLE left, CHASE right. Each row shows the same character twice, full body, consistent proportions and colors. Row 1 SILVERBACK: massive chunky dark gray gorilla, very broad shoulders, silver back and head patch, huge blocky forearms and compact legs, light gray muzzle; friendly gentle giant at rest. Row 2 TRICERATOPS: stocky turquoise four-legged dinosaur, oversized simple polygon frill, exactly three thick ivory horns (two above the eyes, one on nose), short chunky legs and stout tail; cute calm dot eyes at rest. Row 3 ARMORED HELLHOUND: chunky dark plum canine with broad head, simple angular burgundy shoulder and back armor plates, minimal dull orange accents, no flames obscuring silhouette, simple gold collar; looks like a cute sturdy puppy at rest. CHASE transformation in right column: bright red eyes, lowered angry eyebrow shapes, lowered head and forward aggressive pose, open separate hinged lower jaw with dark inside. Silverback and hellhound have only a few big simple triangular fangs; triceratops keeps a simple open BEAK without carnivore fangs, charges horns forward. Convey a scary chase mode through expression and posture while preserving the cute economical base mesh. No gore, no realism, no intricate armor, no fur or scale textures, no realistic muscles, no dense faceted sphere shapes. Clean ivory background, faint ground shadows, roomy landscape sheet, exactly six character depictions. Top title 'ELITE GUARDS — TIER 5', column labels 'IDLE' and 'CHASE', row labels 'SILVERBACK', 'TRICERATOPS', 'ARMORED HELLHOUND'. All appendages in frame. These are alternative guards within a proposed tier, not a fight scene.
